description: Browser SDK providers: the library and the provider's own SDK run in a real browser page (interop/browser/). Setup: docs/interoperability/google-microsoft.md.

targets.name: Google Identity Services token model (real GIS script, in-browser) with the Google userinfo API

env.name: RA_INTEROP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client ID of a test 'Web application' OAuth client whose authorized JavaScript origins include http://localhost:<port>

env.name: RA_INTEROP_GOOGLE_PORT
env.description: Port of the page origin http://localhost:<port> registered with the client (default 39440)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_GOOGLE_EXPECTED_EMAIL
env.description: Email of the dedicated test account (required): userinfo's email must match it (compared in memory, never printed); also sent as login_hint

env.name: RA_INTEROP_GOOGLE_STORAGE_STATE
env.description: Path of a Playwright storageState file of the dedicated test account (outside the repository or under interop/.auth/; never committed). Without --headed it selects session mode: the GIS popup must complete with prompt=none or the scenario fails closed

targets.name: Microsoft Entra ID through MSAL.js v5 (real @azure/msal-browser, in-browser, v5 redirect bridge) with Microsoft Graph /me

software.name: Microsoft Entra ID with @azure/msal-browser
software.version: msal-browser 5.x (the installed devDependency, bundled into the page)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_MSAL_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Application (client) ID of a test Entra app registration with the SPA redirect URI http://localhost:<port>/redirect.html

env.name: RA_INTEROP_MSAL_PORT
env.description: Port of the page origin http://localhost:<port> (default 39441)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_MSAL_EXPECTED_UPN
env.description: userPrincipalName of the dedicated test account (required): Graph /me must match it (compared in memory, never printed); also sent as loginHint

env.name: RA_INTEROP_MSAL_STORAGE_STATE
env.description: Path of a Playwright storageState file of the dedicated test account (outside the repository or under interop/.auth/; never committed). Without --headed it selects session mode: the MSAL popup must complete with prompt=none or the scenario fails closed
